description: This file is a shell script that benchmarks the performance of adding files to a Git object database, testing different core.fsync modes and configurations.

methods.name: populate_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of unique files within directories for testing.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository, makes an initial commit, and populates it with files.

methods.name: test_perf_fsync_cfgs
methods.description: Runs performance tests under different git core.fsync configurations.
